svg.title: Adam Rudavský
svg.desc: Measurement board for Adam Rudavský (XVADUR): approximately 2.4M own words archived in Core V2, 2017–2026, through 2026-10-14; automatic classification gives 2,409,914 words after matching archive copies. Separately, Korpus indexes 646,607 human words (2026-01-17 to 2026-10-12) across 159 writing days, snapshot 2026-10-13; 588 workspace commits across 13 local repositories (2026-09-02 to 2026-10-11); Codex reports 22.4B lifetime tokens and Claude Code reports 14.4B total tokens, from screenshots received 2026-10-11.
